audit.why: Packet defect said the page never names Yone's abilities — that applies to the FULL layer templates; the content layer names Q3, Soul Unbound, Sanguine Pool interactions correctly. Pool negating Q3 knock-up (untargetable) and thereby denying the airborne target Fate Sealed needs is the decisive interaction; now stated on the full layer too. Content's 'E-dash' shorthand for Soul Unbound's speed-boosted engage left alone — colloquial, not a fabricated name.
Kit: E 22-10s, W 14s base scaling with attack speed, Vlad W 28s.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Sanguine Pool has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - His W shield recycles every 14s, faster with attack speed — trade right after it breaks. - Your 28s Pool has one job: his Q3-R engage, nothing less.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: Q3 knocks airborne and Fate Sealed needs the hit — Pool the third Q and his whole engage resets on nothing.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: A held E charge inside Q3 range is the setup he practices — the knock-up lands before your release pays you anything back.

edits.before: Q-farm and nothing else — your level 1 is among the worst mid. Give CS you can't Q safely and smile about it.
edits.after: His Mortal Steel poke and E windup beat your worst-in-class level 1 — give up the CS you can't Q safely.

edits.before: Still surviving. Q on cooldown when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen yet.
edits.after: He still out-damages you and you lack W to escape a setup. Q when free, pool comes next level.

edits.before: E charges join the pattern: Q-E wave contact trades start mattering. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.
edits.after: Q3 knock-up plus Soul Unbound burst arrives — a combo you can't answer yet. Health is mana — spend like an accountant.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Crimson Rush tilts the sustain war, but his empowered Q3-E all-in still outraces your heal ticks.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Hemoplague online — Pool his Q3 knock-up, flip the all-in, and the extended drain fight finally pays you out.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: His Shieldbow-crit spike lands first — Q3 gap-close dive outpaces your one-item sustain; respect the crash.
